tools.name: balena_get_current_user
tools.description: Return the Balena user that the configured API key belongs to. Use it to confirm which account the tools act for. Balena API: GET /user/v1/whoami.

tools.name: balena_list_applications
tools.description: List the applications (fleets) the key can access, optionally only those in one organization (by handle). Each row has id, app_name, slug and the device type. Returns { d: [...] }. Balena API: GET /v7/application.

tools.name: balena_get_application
tools.description: Get one application by numeric id or by slug (org/app), with the devices it owns (expanded). Balena API: GET /v7/application(<id>) or GET /v7/application?$filter=slug eq '<slug>'.

tools.name: balena_list_devices
tools.description: List devices, optionally only those in one application and/or only online or offline devices. Returns id, uuid, device_name, is_online, overall_status, status, last_connectivity_event and version fields. Balena API: GET /v7/device.

tools.name: balena_get_device
tools.description: Get one device by uuid or numeric id, with its application expanded. Balena API: GET /v7/device(uuid='<uuid>')?$expand=belongs_to__application or GET /v7/device(<id>).

tools.name: balena_get_device_health
tools.description: Get one device's online state, overall_status, last connectivity event, CPU, memory and storage figures. Balena API: GET /v7/device(uuid='<uuid>')?$select=....

tools.name: balena_list_releases
tools.description: List the releases (builds) of one application, optionally only the release with one commit hash. Returns id, commit, raw_version, status and is_invalidated. Balena API: GET /v7/release.

tools.name: balena_get_release
tools.description: Get one release by its numeric id. Balena API: GET /v7/release(<id>).

tools.name: balena_rename_device
tools.description: Set the display name of one device. It changes only the name; it does not touch the running software. Balena API: PATCH /v7/device(uuid='<uuid>') with { device_name }.

tools.name: balena_add_device_note
tools.description: Replace the free-text note on one device, for example an owner or a location reminder. It does not touch the running software. Balena API: PATCH /v7/device(uuid='<uuid>') with { note }.
